thread:
sophia: GA rollout for SAIL (sail-7b) in Hosted is scheduled for 2025-07-20 16:00 PT. This thread is the official ops + migration callout. Please read and escalate anything that looks off. :tada:

sophia: Quick summary: new model endpoint POST /v1/generate/sail, streaming + tool-calling enabled, client SDKs updated, old endpoint /v1/generate/marlin will be deprecated in 60 days but supported during migration. Canary 5% for 20m, then 25% for 40m, full roll at ~3h if healthy.

sophia: Important policy notes:
- Per-key soft RPS will change from 12 -> 10 rps; burst window 30 -> 24. This is a soft default for unpinned keys only.
- Pinning behavior: keys that pin to marlin will continue routing to marlin until they change their config.
- Deprecation: marlin route will return a deprecation header advising migration starting day 1.

mike: Can you paste the rollback commands?

sophia: Rollback snippet (ops runbook):
```
# set previous backend and drain
redwoodctl deploy set-backend sail --version roll-prev --force
redwoodctl route update /v1/generate/sail --weight 0
```
Then file a rollback ticket and notify #eng-oncall.

emma: Monitoring checklist for canary:
- Console > Models > sail-7b: watch p50/p90 p95 latency, token throughput
- Errors: 5xx > 0.7% OR increased client-side timeouts -> pager
- Cost signals: token/sec anomalies (ops-billing dashboard)
- Autoscaler note: keep spike-mode disabled for first hour, enable if 95th percentile CPU remains < 70%

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started at 2025-07-20T23:00:10Z  allocation: sail-hosted-2:5%

jordan: Client migration snippet for SDKs (paste into quickstart):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate/sail" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"Hello world","stream":true,"tool_calls":["http_call"]}'
```
Note: set "stream": false if you don't want chunked responses.

ops-bot: Reminder: rate-limit change will be applied to unpinned keys at 2025-07-20T16:10 PT. Contact eng-platform for customer exceptions.

mike: Any runtime kernel/quant notes?

sophia: sail-7b uses the new fused-attn kernel and default int8 quant profile. We validated quality on our eval suite; please flag any regressions in #eng-ml-evals.

emma: If anyone sees client-facing regressions escalate to #incidents immediately. I'll be watching metrics and coordinating with oncall.

sophia: Thanks all — cheers to launch :rocket:
